sentences.en: A relationship based on total honesty is bound to fail.
sentences.zh: 建立在完全坦诚基础上的关系注定要失败。

sentences.en: Finally, their friendship ended and their close relationship disappeared.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们的友谊结束了，亲密的关系消失了。

sentences.en: Common causes of stress are work and human relationships.
sentences.zh: 压力的常见原因有工作和人际关系。

senses.zh: 关系，联系；关系，交往；亲属关系
